headline: Aurora DevCloud Confirms Ransomware Breach Exposing 3.6 Million Developer Accounts
summary: Singapore-based code-hosting vendor Aurora DevCloud disclosed a ransomware breach that exposed approximately 3.6 million developer accounts, including hashed credentials and source-code metadata. The BlueGale ransomware group claimed responsibility and demanded a $14 million ransom. CISO Reed Tanaka said the company will not pay and filed notification with regulators 11 days after detection. Tracked as CVE-2026-31104.
key_points: Aurora DevCloud confirmed 3.6 million developer accounts exposed in the breach
BlueGale ransomware group claimed responsibility and demanded $14 million
Disclosure was filed with regulators 11 days after the initial detection
The vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-31104 in the public catalogue

source_documents.title: Aurora DevCloud — Notice of Cybersecurity Incident
source_documents.quote_text: We confirm an unauthorized actor accessed our developer-account store. We will not pay the ransom and have filed notification with regulators.
